definitions: Used to express that something was possible but did not happen.
Used to suggest that something is not as bad as it might have been.
Used to dismiss a past possibility as irrelevant or not worth dwelling on.
examples: It could have been a disaster, but luckily no one was hurt.
The movie was okay, but it could have been so much better.
He could have been a doctor, but he chose a different path.
She was upset, but it could have been worse.
Oh, that could have been me!
